# dsh-qbittorrent
English | 中文

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that registers qBittorrent's WebAPI v2 as
model-facing tools: list a

nd inspect torrents, triage stuck downloads, and
apply a small set of guarded mutations. No browser

window, no MCP subprocess —
the tools are registered natively through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart `dsh web` if the profile does not compose patches on reload.
## Configuration

The plugin works with no configuration. Every key is optional and can be set
in the patch row's `con

lugin works with no configuration. Every key is optional and can be set
in the patch row's `config`:
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `url` | `http://127.0.0.1:8080` | qBittorrent WebUI origin (`QBT_URL` env also honoured) |
| `toke
nRef` | `QBT_API_KEY` | Credential name holding the Bearer token (`QBT_TOKEN_REF` env also honoured)

|
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request deadline |
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**The token is never stored in a patch file.** It is resolved through the DSH
credential service by

name, falling back to `process.env`. qBittorrent v5.2.x
accepts only `Authorization: Bearer <token>`

here; `X-API-Key`, `api-key` and
query-parameter forms all return 403.
## Tools
Nine tools are registered:
| Tool | Purpose |

| `qb_status` | Version, WebAPI version, per-state torrent counts, transfer stats |
| `qb_list_torre

nts` | List with `filter` / `category` / `tag` / `hashes` / `sort`, capped at 200 items |
| `qb_torr

ent_detail` | One torrent's properties plus file list |
| `qb_list_categories` | Every category and

its save path |
| `qb_find_orphans` | Torrents whose metadata never resolved, whose name is still th

e bare infohash, or that error / miss files |
| `qb_resume_torrent` | Resume — requires `confirm: tr

ue` |
| `qb_pause_torrent` | Pause — requires `confirm: true` |
| `qb_set_category` | Move into a ca

tegory — requires `confirm: true` |
| `qb_delete_torrent` | Remove — requires `confirm: true` plus `
expect` matching the hash count; max 20 per call; `deleteFiles: true` also erases data on disk |

Write calls refuse to run without `confirm: true`. An API failure returns as a
tool result rather th
an an exception, so one bad call does not end the turn.
A GitHub Release carries a version-free `dsh-qbittorrent.tgz` built by CI, for prebuilt installs.
## Requirements

- DSH `>=0.2.0-rc.1`
- Node >= 18 (global `fetch` and `AbortSignal.timeout`)
- qBittorrent WebAPI v2

1`
- Node >= 18 (global `fetch` and `AbortSignal.timeout`)
- qBittorrent WebAPI v2 with an API token

No runtime dependencies. `@deepseek-ai/cordis` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` are
peer dependencies su
pplied by the harness.
